name: fathomdb-linux-arm64-gnu-tegra
//version: Deliberately absent. scripts/release/build-napi-cuda-tegra.sh stamps the main fathomdb package's version into a staged copy, so a packed Tegra tarball always matches the main package it was built with. The loader refuses a mismatched pair.
description: CUDA-capable FathomDB native binding for classic NVIDIA Jetson Orin (JetPack 6 / L4T R36, CUDA 12.6). Distributed only as an exact-version tarball from the FathomDB Tegra Pages site; never an optional dependency of the `fathomdb` package.
